name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Rest barbell securely across upper traps, feet shoulder-width, toes turned slightly out.
Brace core, sit hips down and back between your knees.
Descend until thighs are parallel or just below parallel to the floor.
Drive out of the hole through midfoot and heels to stand tall.
coachTips: Screw your feet into the floor to activate hip external rotators.
breathingTip: Big diaphragmatic breath and brace at top; exhale past sticking point on way up.
progressionNote: Add 2.5-5kg weekly when hitting 4x8 with deep, upright mechanics.

name: Goblet Squat (Knee-Friendly)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Keep torso upright and squat down between your hips.
Elbows should track inside knees at the bottom.
Drive through heels to stand.
coachTips: The anterior counterweight naturally encourages an upright torso and healthy knee tracking.
breathingTip: Inhale going down; exhale standing up.
progressionNote: Progress weight of dumbbell or switch to barbell front squat.

name: Box Squat (Knee & Back Safe)
instructions: Stand a few inches in front of a box or bench.
Hinge hips back and sit down onto the box with full control.
Pause for 1 second without rocking or releasing core tension.
Explode upward through heels to standing.
commonMistakes: Plummeting onto box and bouncing off
coachTips: Eliminates patellofemoral knee shear by maintaining vertical shins.
breathingTip: Inhale on descent; exhale pushing up.
progressionNote: Lower box height as hip mobility improves.

name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
instructions: Hold weights in front of thighs with slight soft knee bend.
Push hips straight backwards as if closing a car door with your butt.
Lower weights along shins until you feel a deep stretch in hamstrings.
Drive hips forward to stand tall and squeeze glutes.
coachTips: Shins stay completely vertical. Move through the hips, not the knees.
breathingTip: Inhale hinging back; exhale thrusting hips forward.
progressionNote: Master with dumbbells before loading heavy barbells.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rest top of rear foot on a bench behind you, front foot placed forward.
Lower hips straight down until back knee hovers just above the floor.
Push through front heel to return to top.
commonMistakes: Front foot placed too close causing heel lift
coachTips: Lean torso slightly forward at 15 degrees for glute emphasis and knee comfort.
progressionNote: Start with bodyweight, add dumbbells once balance is stable.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit firmly with lower back pressed flush against backrest.
Place feet shoulder-width on sled.
Lower sled under control until knees reach 90 degrees.
Press sled up through midfoot without hyper-locking knees.
commonMistakes: Butt lifting off seat at bottom
coachTips: Never let your lower back curl off the pad at bottom.
breathingTip: Inhale coming down; exhale pressing out.
progressionNote: High foot placement shifts focus to glutes/hamstrings; low shifts to quads.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on machine with pad resting just beneath calves.
Curl heels toward glutes smoothly.
Squeeze at peak contraction, lower with control over 2 seconds.
commonMistakes: Hips lifting up off pad during the curl
coachTips: Dorsiflex ankles (point toes toward shins) for greater hamstring recruitment.
breathingTip: Exhale curling up; inhale lowering down.

name: Swiss Ball / Slider Leg Curl (Home Friendly)
instructions: Lie on back with heels on a Swiss ball or floor sliders.
Lift hips into a bridge position.
Curl heels towards butt while keeping hips elevated.
Extend legs back out with control.
commonMistakes: Hips dropping to floor during curl
coachTips: Zero spinal compression; outstanding knee rehabilitation exercise.
breathingTip: Exhale curling in; inhale rolling out.
progressionNote: Progress to single-leg curls as strength develops.

name: Walking Dumbbell Lunges
instructions: Step forward with right leg, lowering back knee towards floor.
Front knee should stay stacked above ankle.
Drive up through front heel and step through with left leg.
Repeat smoothly across a walking path.
commonMistakes: Knee tracking too far past toes and collapsing inward
coachTips: Take a slightly wider stride width to enhance stability.
breathingTip: Continuous rhythmic breathing with each step.
progressionNote: Increase dumbbell weight held at sides.

name: Leg Extension Machine
instructions: Sit with knees aligned with machine pivot point, shin pad above ankles.
Extend legs upward until straight, squeezing quads at peak.
Lower slowly with control.
coachTips: Isolates quadriceps completely; keep reps strict and controlled.
progressionNote: Pause at top for 2 seconds for intense quad pump.
